Initial management
Below the age of 1 year, all children fulfilling the definition of nephrotic

Kidney biopsy
The prognosis for childhood nephrotic syndrome is best predicted by the
patient’s response to initial treatment and frequency of relapse during the
first year after treatment. Therefore, a kidney biopsy is not usually needed
at initial presentation unless the patient displays steroid resistance, has an
atypical clinical course, or is > 12 years of age at presentation.
